summary:
Frontend-only Playwright E2E testing (1920x1080 and 1920x800) of the burger menu catalogue, stock and restock, the 4-slot grill with multiple and spare patties, the new drinks preparation flow, the tutorial, and regression of register, fryer, assembly, packing, summary and save. All requested features work and no console or page errors were seen in any run. One real bug was found: pressing Esc to close the Buku Menu dialog also opens the Pause menu. The other findings are minor UX issues.

What passed:
- Menu Burger screen: 116 of 116 menus. Names and ingredient combinations are unique (checked in the DOM and in node). Every menu starts with Roti Bawah and ends with Roti Atas, and every menu shows 'Nama Menu:' and 'Bahan:'. Filters return special 4, beef 30, double 31, veg 31, none 20, all 116. Searching 'Keju' returns 50.
- Buku Menu during a shift: the timer stays frozen while the dialog is open, with no pause overlay, and resumes after closing. stock-* counts are shown. 'Pesan +10' changes to a disabled 'Dihantar…' button; the delivery does not progress while the dialog is open and arrives about 15 game seconds after closing (pickle 2 -> 12). menu-status shows Tersedia, 'Dibuka pada Hari N', and 'Tidak tersedia — stok habis: Jeruk' (32 menus when Jeruk is at 0). The missing ingredient is highlighted red. 'Hanya yang tersedia' gives 64 on Day 3 and 32 with Jeruk at 0.
- Assembly stock: 'Stok: n' goes down when a layer is added and comes back on undo. At 0 the button is disabled and shows 'Stok habis'.
- Grill: 4 slots. 'Letak Semua (4)' filled all 4 slots for a ticket with 2 Double burgers, and the spare button is disabled when the grill is full. Spare 'Simpanan' patties cook correctly and can be used in assembly for a ticket (asm-add-patty_beef is enabled with spares and disabled once they are used). When a ticket leaves, its patties become Simpanan.
- Drinks: 27 types. Prepare is disabled until type, size and temperature are chosen. Temperatures are disabled before a type is picked; Kola allows only sejuk. The qty +/- buttons work. Prepare adds cups and the status becomes 'Sedang Disediakan'. Removing a cup and clearing the tray both work.
- Drink checking: a partial batch gives 'belum lengkap — 1/2 disediakan'. Wrong cups give 'Perlu Dibetulkan' with messages such as 'Salah jenis Kola (sepatutnya Soda Oren), saiz Besar (sepatutnya Sederhana)' and the red feedback box. When everything is correct the status is 'Siap', drinks-complete is shown, and the summary reads '2 · 2'.
- Tutorial end-to-end: Pak Hamid's bill is RM9.50 and the RM0.50 change is accepted. The wrong-size attempt does not advance the step and the correct Kola, saiz kecil, sejuk does. Packing and delivery work, and the real shift starts.
- Full Day 5 order (veg patty, bites, 3 fries): served with 5 stars and 100 accuracy.
- Six paid orders on Day 5 at 10x speed, with drinks prepared: summary ledger sales RM96.60 = sum of the bills; 96.60 + 1.20 - 1.10 - 96.60 = 0.10; 300 + 0.10 - 25 = 275.10. The save advances to day 6.
- 1920x800: no page overflow.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Esc to close the Buku Menu dialog also opens the Pause menu, so the game stays paused behind 'Permainan Dijeda'. Reproduced every time when focus is not on an input. Root cause: Radix handles Escape on document in the capture phase and dispatches CLOSE_MENU. React flushes that update, so ref.current.menuOpen is already false when the window keydown listener runs, and the listener dispatches PAUSE. Closing with the X button works correctly.

While any cups are in the tray, every drink line shows 'Sedang Disediakan', even lines with no cups in the tray. A line with old issues keeps showing 'Perlu Dibetulkan' while the student is re-preparing it. A partially correct line (1/2) falls back to 'Belum Disediakan' instead of 'Sedang Disediakan'.

Spare (Simpanan) patties already in the tray are not subtracted from the count. With 2 spares ready, the grill still says 'perlu 4 patty daging lagi', and 'Letak Semua' cooks 4 more, which wastes patties and stock.
For a veg-only ticket the text reads 'perlu 0 patty daging, 1 patty sayur lagi'. The 0-count part should be hidden.

issues: The tutorial card at the bottom left is wider than the ticket rail (about 290px against 253px) and overlaps the rail and station panel border.
If another ticket's cups are in the tray, the current ticket's tray shows 'Dulang kosong' and Sediakan only gives a toast warning. Show which ticket is holding the tray.

action_items: Fix Esc on Buku Menu opening Pause: add onEscapeKeyDown={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()} to the menu DialogContent, or have useKeys ignore Escape for a short time after CLOSE_MENU, or check document.querySelector('[role=dialog]') at keydown in the capture phase
Drink line status: base 'Sedang Disediakan' on cups in the tray that match that line, and clear drinkIssues for a line once new cups are added for it
pattiesNeeded: subtract unassigned spare patties of the same type, or say how many spares are available
Hide '0 patty daging' in grill-selected-info for veg-only tickets
critical_code_review_comments: Restocking ('Pesan +10') costs nothing; it is not added to ledger.ingredients. Decide whether restocking should cost money as a business-maths element.
missingStock counts all tray patties of a type, including those assigned to other orders, so it can slightly over-report availability.
MenuDialog's missingFn useCallback depends on the whole state, so it is recreated every render and the menu list is re-memoised each tick. This is harmless while paused but wasteful.
config.js day mapping: Day 1 has 11 burgers and 4 drinks, and Day 5 has 116 burgers and 27 drinks, as intended.
updated_files: /app/tests/rb_helpers.py (new, helper JS for bill computation in Playwright)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; 1 medium bug, 3 low UX issues)

seed_data_creation: None. A localStorage save rushbite_save_v1 was injected for day 3 and day 5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ?speed=3&seed=4242 on Day 3 gives #101 (2 Double burgers needing 4 patties, plus 2 Soda Oren M sejuk), #102 (3 Double burgers) and #103. Day 5 with seed 4242 gives a veg burger with bites and fries. The bill can be computed from the receipt-line text ('RMx × q') minus receipt-discount (see /app/tests/rb_helpers.py PAY_JS). Fry-start buttons stay present but disabled while frying, so use :not([disabled]). Grill timing polling works at speed 3 but is too tight at speed 10. To deplete pickle, add 9 pickles to one burger (the cap is 12 layers), finish it, then add 1 more on the next burger.
rca of the issue: Esc -> Pause: the Radix Dialog escape listener (document, capture phase) dispatches CLOSE_MENU before the window bubble listener in useKeys runs. By then ref.current.menuOpen is false, so the listener treats Escape as a pause toggle. Mitigation: stop propagation in onEscapeKeyDown on the DialogContent.
